title: Photos, videos and files in the timeline
summary: Timeline rows for images, videos, stickers and files: a blurred preview while loading, the media itself when it may show, the caption under it, and the upload progress of own media. A tap opens media-viewer or the file.

kind.description: From the message type. Voice and audio are voice-message rows.

sizeLabel.description: File size, already formatted by the system ("2,4 MB").

width.description: Pixels, for the row aspect ratio.

height.description: Pixels, for the row aspect ratio.

blurhash.description: The blurred placeholder from the event.

display.description: placeholder: blurhash only, before the thumbnail loads. tapToShow: the show-media setting hides it until a tap. loading: downloading. shown: the thumbnail or image shows. failed: the download failed.

uploadProgress.description: Own media while sending: percent 0 to 100.

media.description: The row. Sender, time, reactions, reply quote and receipts come from timeline-rows MessageDetails.

showMedia.description: The setting bipe_chats_show_media: always, only in DMs and closed groups, or only on tap.

appear.effect: Loads the thumbnail (or the image when it has none) through the media cache when display may show it.

tapToShow.effect: Shows media hidden by showMedia for this message.

open.effect: image, video, sticker: opens media-viewer. file: downloads the file to the cache and opens the system preview or share sheet.

cancelUpload.effect: Own media while sending: cancels the send and removes the row.

notes: Encrypted media: the event's MediaSource holds the key; the SDK downloads and decrypts on the phone. Media never goes through a Bipe server other than the homeserver.
showMedia privateOnly: media shows in DMs and in groups that need an invite; in a public group it waits for a tap. The setting row lives in the Conversas e mídia group of settings.
The row keeps its size from width and height before the media loads, so the timeline does not jump. Without size: a 4:3 box.
bipe_app_media_image, _video, _file and _sticker are the accessibility labels, and the preview text in replies, the chat list and notifications (message-reply, notification-service).
Captions show under the media as text, and the scam warning reads the caption (scam-warning). A caption is edited with message-edit (EditedContent.MediaCaption).
Stickers show without a bubble, at most 160 points wide, animated when ImageInfo.isAnimated. Saving stickers is the stickers issue (bipe_action_save_sticker).
A photo that is a receipt image gets no special card here; the receipt scam check reads text only.
Delete and forward come from message-actions; media delete uses message-delete (bipe_dm_media_delete_body is the media library text, not this row).
